svg.title: PRD view 2: make modules actionable
svg.desc: Expand the booking module inside the same PRD All text and relationships stay visible. Motion demonstrates inputs, progress and retained outputs. The complete diagram remains readable with animation off or reduced motion. Concrete tasks implement and verify each module requirement.
